eips.title: Trustless log and transaction index
eips.summary: Raised as the reason to hold the proposed eth_getLogsV2 endpoint: new log endpoints should be trustless-compatible.

moments.context: Łukasz Rozmej suggested the proposed endpoint could be made to work with the Trustless Log Index "so we can have both".
Łukasz said he would be "very reluctant to add new endpoints that are not compatible with" the trustless Ethereum roadmap, citing the EIP for the Trustless Log Index.
lightclient restated Łukasz's position for Boma: the trustless log index is the approach that should be looked at, rather than the proposed endpoint.
Łukasz said going trustless would be his main priority over adding things that are "somewhat obsolete, because they are not trustless", and that anything added should be trustless compatible.
